attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: who have become perfect with you.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M

attributions.surface_quote: maker of multiplicity, in dividing all those who really are

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: You possess them all without birth, eternally, imperishably.

attributions.surface_quote: You are a triple power, you are a threefold replication.

attributions.surface_quote: We are a shadow of you, as you are a shadow of that first preexistent one.

canonical_statement: The human soul possesses an inherent, eternal nature.

attributions.surface_quote: We are eternal.

canonical_statement: The primordial, unborn source is the origin from which all subsequent eternal realms and beings emanate.

attributions.surface_quote: From you come the eternal ones and eternal realms.

canonical_statement: The ultimate source of reality is a non-being that precedes all existence and ontological categories.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: reality before realities, first being before beings

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is self-referential and possesses self-knowledge independent of external objects.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: who know yourself through yourself alone

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is the singular, uncaused cause of all subsequent existence.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: There is nothing active prior to you.

canonical_statement: Salvation is defined as the attainment of direct cognitive awareness of the ultimate reality.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: Knowledge of you is our salvation.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is transcendent and not subject to the processes of salvation or change.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: you who will not be saved nor have been saved by them

canonical_statement: Human perception of the ultimate reality is mediated through the faculty of the mind.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: We have seen you through mind.

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine principle is ineffable and transcends all finite naming.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: How shall we give you a name? We have none.

canonical_statement: The divine substrate is composed of the triad of existence, life, and mind.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: You are their existence, you are their life, you are their mind.

canonical_statement: The divine principle is self-originated and self-contained.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: O hidden one... who conceived himself. You are in you.

canonical_statement: The divine principle exists prior to all temporal and causal sequences.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: You are before you, and after you none have come to act.

canonical_statement: The divine principle is the singular source and generator of all subordinate powers.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: You generator of powers.

canonical_statement: The act of remembering and glorifying divine truths grants the practitioner perfection and liberation from suffering.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: Whoever remembers these and always glorifies will be perfect among the perfect and free of suffering.

canonical_statement: The metaphysical structure of reality involves a hierarchical ascent and descent through distinct levels of existence.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: The way of ascent is the way of descent.

canonical_statement: The individual consciousness possesses the inherent capacity to comprehend and internalize infinite truths.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: You have taught yourselves about things infinite.

canonical_statement: The visionary experience of the divine is an internal process of deepening insight rather than an external ascent.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: visionary experience is understood not as an ascent upward... but rather as an inner experience

canonical_statement: The divine is located within the self and is accessed through internal contemplation.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: the foreigner envisions within self aspects of the divine

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine principle transcends all categories of existence, comprehension, and predication.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: It is not something that exists... but something greater, which no one can understand.

canonical_statement: The highest divine reality is characterized by stillness, silence, and absolute unknowability.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: the mediation of the triple power, which is located in stillness and silence and is unknowable.

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine principle lacks attributes such as mind, life, action, or causal agency.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: For it has no mind, no life, nothing real—and nothing unreal, incomprehensibly.

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine principle is self-contained and does not engage in processes of giving, receiving, or causing.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: there is nothing at all left over, as if it causes something to be undertaken.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality exists beyond the categories of existence and non-existence.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: It is not something that exists... but something greater.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is self-contained and lacks any dependency on external entities or attributes.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: It has no need of mind or life or anything.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality transcends all binary oppositions and qualitative descriptors.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: It is not corporeal and is not incorporeal. It is not large and it is not small.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is defined by self-knowledge, as it is the only entity capable of understanding itself.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: It is a first revelation and knowledge of itself, since it alone understands itself.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality exists outside the constraints of time and the eternal realm.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: It is not part of an eternal realm nor time.

canonical_statement: The human soul is capable of transcending the physical body to traverse higher metaphysical realms.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C

canonical_statement: Human beings possess an inherent divine nature that requires awakening.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: Awaken your divinity to divinity

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: Observe the constant change that is here and seek the unchanging state

canonical_statement: The human condition is defined by metaphysical imprisonment that must be actively transcended.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: You have come not to suffer but to break your fetters.

canonical_statement: The soul is a distinct, salvageable component of the human entity.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: Save yourselves so that part 6 may be saved.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: Look to the light, fly from the darkness.

canonical_statement: Ritual baptism functions as a metaphysical seal that grants immunity to death.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M

canonical_statement: Knowledge and enlightenment are the primary objectives of spiritual transformation.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: The point of baptism... is knowledge and enlightenment.

canonical_statement: Gnosis, or the understanding of truth, confers immortality upon the individual.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: those baptized have been instructed and have understood, and they will not taste death.

canonical_statement: Spiritual baptism functions as a mechanism to transcend the limitations of the celestial realms.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: the baptism that surpasses the heavens

canonical_statement: The material or lower cosmic powers can be neutralized through the application of divine knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: He has nailed down the powers of the thirteen realms and neutralized them

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M

attributions.surface_quote: baptism that surpasses heaven.

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine principle is self-originated and lacks external dependency.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: You, self-conceived, lacking nothing, being independent

attributions.surface_quote: invisible to all except me

canonical_statement: Individual identity is realized through union with the eternal divine constancy.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: Having known you, I now have mingled with your constancy.

canonical_statement: The divine essence is characterized by eternal, unchanging existence.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: being who exists forever

canonical_statement: Human transformation involves the acquisition of a luminous, grace-filled spiritual state.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: I have put on armor of grace and light and have become bright.

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine reality is formless and exists beyond the realm of manifested beings.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: formless one existing among formless ones

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness can be purified and elevated into the eternal life of the divine.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: raising the person by whom you will purify me into your life

canonical_statement: The divine essence acts as a foundational place of rest for the soul.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: You are my place of rest

canonical_statement: Material reality is a model or reflection of higher spiritual truths.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: I have mixed it with water as a model for all the rulers

canonical_statement: The divine essence is liberated from the constraints of the material world.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: liberation from the material world

canonical_statement: The deity is pantheistic, existing as a pervasive force within all matter and life.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: a pantheistic deity that permeates matter and life

canonical_statement: The soul or divine spark undergoes a process of return to its origin.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: the promise of salvation of return

attributions.surface_quote: Antithesis and paradox may be used to proclaim the absolute transcendence

attributions.surface_quote: greatness is incomprehensible and whose being is unfathomable.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: What you see outdoors you see within you.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: the woman is the universal paradigm.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: the woman relentlessly contradicts herself.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is identical to the seeker's process of searching for it.

attributions.surface_quote: she is the knowledge of her search

canonical_statement: Internalizing the divine principle grants liberation from the cycle of death.

attributions.surface_quote: There they will find me and live, and they will not die again.

canonical_statement: The divine essence exists outside the constraints of temporal and spatial location.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: In no place, in no time, be unknowing of me.

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine identity encompasses all binary opposites and contradictory states simultaneously.

canonical_statement: The divine source exists in a non-linear temporal state where the creator and the created are interchangeable.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the mother of my father and sister of my husband.

canonical_statement: Truth and falsehood are functionally identical when applied to the nature of the absolute.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: You who tell the truth about me lie about me.

canonical_statement: The absolute reality is an incomprehensible silence that manifests as manifold expression.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: I am a silence incomprehensible and an idea remembered often.

canonical_statement: The divine principle or wisdom encompasses and transcends all binary oppositions, including strength and weakness, cruelty and compassion, and life and death.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: I am compassionate and cruel... I am senseless and wise.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is omnipresent and manifests within all social, cultural, and moral conditions, regardless of human perception or judgment.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: I am hated everywhere and loved everywhere.

canonical_statement: Human perception of the divine is inverted, often misidentifying life as death and wisdom as folly.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: I am called life and you have called me death.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality or divine principle encompasses and transcends all binary oppositions and contradictory human categories.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: I am godless and one whose god is great.

canonical_statement: The divine essence is present within the small and the despised, requiring a reversal of human valuation to perceive.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: Come to childhood and don't despise it, because it is small and tiny.

canonical_statement: The relationship between the seeker and the divine is characterized by a reciprocal cycle of concealment and revelation.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: When you hide I show. When you appear I hide.

canonical_statement: The divine is an integrated totality that exists simultaneously as the source and the scattered fragments within the material world.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: I am one you scattered and gathered together.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a paradoxical unity encompassing all binary opposites and contradictory states.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: I am substance and one without substance. I am union and dissolution.

canonical_statement: The divine essence is both the source of existence and the underlying substrate of all created natures.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: I am the substance and one without substance.

canonical_statement: Knowledge of the divine is characterized by a dialectical relationship where proximity and distance are inverted.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: On the day I am close to you, you are far.

canonical_statement: The divine principle is the origin of both moral order and the root of transgression.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: I am sinless, and the root of sin comes from me.

canonical_statement: The divine essence exists as both the transcendent alien and the immanent citizen of reality.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: I am alien and citizen.

canonical_statement: The internal state of the individual is a direct reflection of the external world, and vice versa.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: What is in you is outside, and one who fashions you on the outside shapes you inside.

canonical_statement: The individual possesses the capacity for judgment within themselves, rendering external judgment redundant.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: because in you the judge and partiality exist.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality or divine source encompasses all contradictory qualities simultaneously.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: I am called truth and iniquity.

canonical_statement: The perceived material world is a manifestation or garment of an underlying, invisible reality.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: It is visible and your garment.

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine entity exists in absolute singularity, transcending all external judgment or moral categorization.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: I alone exist and have no one to judge me.

canonical_statement: Human existence is characterized by a cycle of sensory delusion that concludes upon the soul's return to its primordial origin.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: people until they sober up and float up to their place of rest.

canonical_statement: The state of true existence is defined by the cessation of mortality and the attainment of eternal life.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: There they will find me and live, and they will not die again.

canonical_statement: The material world and the aeons are characterized by a fundamental state of deficiency or ontological lack.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C
attributions.surface_quote: The revelation about the deficiency of the aeons

canonical_statement: The savior figure possesses authority over the entire world.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: our lord, the savior of the whole world

canonical_statement: The enlightened state is characterized by being filled, whereas the uninitiated state is characterized by lack.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: a prototypal listener, who was lacking but now is filled

canonical_statement: The physical body is a temporary vessel for the enlightened being.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: when he was in the body

canonical_statement: The divine presence is an eternal, omnipresent reality that transcends temporal separation.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: I am Jesus the anointed, who is with you forever.

canonical_statement: The material world is characterized by a state of deficiency or lack relative to the fullness of the aeons.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: We would like to understand the deficiency of the realms and their fullness.

canonical_statement: The current state of human existence is a condition of entrapment within a lower dwelling place.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: How are we detained in this dwelling place?

canonical_statement: The origin of cosmic deficiency is rooted in the disobedience and foolishness of the primordial mother.

attributions.surface_quote: if the dead inherits the living, the living won't die and the dead will survive.

canonical_statement: Existence is defined by the prior state of being alive; those who have never lived cannot undergo death.

attributions.surface_quote: You who find truth are alive; another may die, being alive.

attributions.surface_quote: Winter is the world, summer the other realm.

canonical_statement: Spiritual maturation requires alignment with specific cosmic cycles; actions taken out of season are ineffective.

attributions.surface_quote: At the wrong season no crop is yours.

canonical_statement: The redemptive process involves the reclamation of alienated souls by a divine intermediary.

attributions.surface_quote: He rescued and redeemed, redeeming aliens.

canonical_statement: Duality is an inseparable, unified condition of existence within the manifest world.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: Light and darkness... are inseparably together.

canonical_statement: Manifest phenomena are transient and ultimately return to an undifferentiated source.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: Each element fades to an original source.

canonical_statement: Entities existing in the transcendent realm are immutable and eternal.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: Those who live above the world cannot fade. They are eternal.

canonical_statement: Linguistic labels for metaphysical concepts are illusory and distinct from the realities they signify.

attributions.chapter: L I T E R A T U R E OF G N O S T I C W I S D O M
attributions.surface_quote: The names of earthly things are illusory.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is ineffable and cannot be expressed through worldly language.

attributions.surface_quote: Only one name is not uttered in the world.

canonical_statement: The ultimate source of existence is identified by a name that transcends all other designations.

attributions.surface_quote: Above the name of all others is the father's name.

canonical_statement: Cognition and conceptual thought are dependent upon the existence of names.

attributions.surface_quote: Truth made names in the world, and without them we can't think.

canonical_statement: Truth is a singular essence that manifests through a multiplicity of forms.

attributions.surface_quote: Truth is one and is many, teaching one thing through the many.

attributions.surface_quote: They took the names of the good and gave them to the not good.

canonical_statement: Certain metaphysical forces sustain their existence through the ritual sacrifice of life.

attributions.surface_quote: If we are saved there will be no sacrifices, no animals offered to the forces.

canonical_statement: The transition from animalistic existence to human consciousness requires a divine intervention of spiritual nourishment.

canonical_statement: Visible historical events are governed by an unseen, autonomous spiritual agency.

canonical_statement: Truth is omnipresent as a latent potential, though its realization is rare.

attributions.surface_quote: In himself Christ has everything, be it human or angel or mystery and the father.

attributions.surface_quote: The holy spirit blinds the powers who suppose they are treating a simple man.

attributions.surface_quote: Sophia is barren... Yet wherever others are will be the holy spirit. Her children are many.

attributions.surface_quote: What a father has belongs to his child, but not

canonical_statement: The nature of an entity is determined by its mode of origin, distinguishing between created beings and engendered beings.

attributions.surface_quote: Some people travel long but go nowhere.

canonical_statement: The divine process involves the unification of diverse worldly manifestations into a singular, pure essence.

attributions.surface_quote: Wisdom, who is called 'barren,' is mother of the angels.

attributions.surface_quote: If a blind man and one who sees are together in darkness, they are the same.

canonical_statement: The essence of the individual precedes their manifestation in physical existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Blessings on you who were before you came into being.

canonical_statement: Human superiority over other species is derived from an internal, non-apparent quality.

attributions.surface_quote: The superiority of humans is not obvious to the eye but lies in what is hidden.

canonical_statement: Ritual participation without internal spiritual transformation is merely a superficial appropriation of identity.

attributions.surface_quote: I came to make things below like things above

attributions.surface_quote: Beyond it there is nothing inside.

attributions.surface_quote: The rulers do not see you who wear the perfect light

attributions.surface_quote: If the woman and man had not come apart, they would not know death

attributions.surface_quote: Soul became spirit. When he was joined to spirit, he spoke words incomprehensible

canonical_statement: The bridal chamber serves as a ritual space for the integration of divine forces.

canonical_statement: Humanity and animal life originate from distinct, separate metaphysical sources.

attributions.surface_quote: Who has been anointed possesses everything: resurrection, light, cross, holy spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: Here I will eat all things, where the tree of knowledge is.

attributions.surface_quote: When you go into the water, you strip naked and put on the living human.

attributions.surface_quote: There was another people. These blessed ones were the chosen ones.

attributions.surface_quote: Joining is different in the eternal realm, though we use the same names.

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of reality is a singular, undifferentiated unity.

canonical_statement: Self-knowledge is a prerequisite for the conscious experience and utilization of one's inherent spiritual inheritance.

attributions.surface_quote: If you do not know yourself, you will not enjoy what you own.

attributions.surface_quote: Truth is the mother, knowledge the father.

attributions.surface_quote: Who is really free through knowledge is a slave because of love.

attributions.surface_quote: the demiurge orders or fashions the material world out of chaos.

canonical_statement: Human existence involves the entrapment of divine light particles within material flesh.

attributions.surface_quote: the biblical creator who traps particles of light in material flesh.

canonical_statement: The divine pleroma emanates from an infinite, primordial depth.

attributions.surface_quote: Infinite divine manifestation, from which the pleroma of divinity emanates.

canonical_statement: The physical body and material suffering of the divine savior are illusory appearances.

attributions.surface_quote: Christ only appeared or seemed to live in the flesh and suffer.

canonical_statement: Wisdom exists in hierarchical forms, including a lower aspect associated with mortality.

attributions.surface_quote: Achamoth is lower wisdom... Echmoth is like death.

canonical_statement: The cosmos is structured into hierarchical spheres, with the eighth sphere representing a boundary beyond the planetary realms.

attributions.surface_quote: The eighth can also refer to the realm of the fixed stars, beyond the seven spheres.

canonical_statement: The eighth sphere serves as a transitional state for spiritual advancement and the attainment of perfection.

attributions.surface_quote: the eighth sphere is considered a higher level for spiritual advancement and perfection.

canonical_statement: Human identity is categorized by a distinction between the 'elect' or 'perfect' and the uninitiated.

attributions.surface_quote: Elect: Common epithet of those chosen by god, including gnostics.

canonical_statement: Sense perception is fundamentally disconnected from the nature of truth.

attributions.surface_quote: sense perception is not in an

canonical_statement: The divine essence is characterized as a hidden power.

attributions.surface_quote: Elchasai, hidden power, designating the hidden power of god.

canonical_statement: Error functions as a primary ontological force in the manifestation of reality.

attributions.surface_quote: error is personified and plays roles usually assigned to wisdom and the demiurge.

canonical_statement: Fate acts as an inexorable, deterministic force governing both earthly and heavenly realms.

attributions.surface_quote: fate was considered to be the overwhelming force that determines the destiny

canonical_statement: The power of fate transcends the influence of divine beings.

attributions.surface_quote: the power of fate was often thought to exceed that of the gods

canonical_statement: Fate constitutes the ultimate state of bondage for existence.

attributions.surface_quote: fate, then, may be the ultimate bondage.

canonical_statement: The physical body is a temporary vessel or garment assumed at birth and discarded at death.

attributions.surface_quote: Garment: Symbol of the body that is put on at birth and taken off at death.

canonical_statement: The divine realm is structured as a pentad of emanations representing the fullness of the Father.

attributions.surface_quote: Five: realm of the divine father, consisting of Barbelo and four personified attributes.

canonical_statement: The number ten represents a state of perfection and totality within the divine emanation.

attributions.surface_quote: Since the five is androgynous, it is also called the ten, and it constitutes the divine father.

canonical_statement: Ritual acts, such as the five seals, facilitate the soul's ascent to the divine realm.

attributions.surface_quote: Five seals may be linked to gnostic ecstatic ascent to the divine.

canonical_statement: The feminine gender is symbolically associated with the material and earthly realm.

attributions.surface_quote: Female: Gender category used symbolically to designate what is physical and earthly.

canonical_statement: Ecstatic speech is the linguistic medium of the heavenly realms.

attributions.surface_quote: Glossolalia is understood to be the language of the heavenly realms.

canonical_statement: Salvation is achieved through the acquisition of mystical knowledge regarding the divine and the self.

attributions.surface_quote: Knowledge of god and self offers the way of salvation in gnostic texts.

canonical_statement: The Good functions as both an ethical standard and a fundamental metaphysical principle.

attributions.surface_quote: The Good is an ethical and metaphysical principle.

canonical_statement: The divine emanates a primary thought which manifests as a feminine entity.

attributions.surface_quote: Helena, companion of Simon Magus and expression of the first thought of the divine.

canonical_statement: Humanity is ontologically categorized into three distinct levels: hylic, psychic, and pneumatic.

attributions.surface_quote: Hylic: Lowest of three divisions of humanity.

canonical_statement: The divine realm contains a specific hierarchy or group of five entities.

attributions.surface_quote: Husayn... figure of the divine realm of five.

canonical_statement: The term 'human' functions as an epithet for divine beings in addition to earthly beings.

attributions.surface_quote: In Sethian texts 'human' is an epithet of Barbelo.

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine source is an infinite, invisible spirit from which all divinity emanates.

attributions.surface_quote: Invisible spirit: Infinite divine manifestation, from which the pleroma of divinity emanates.

canonical_statement: Self-predication statements function as a mechanism for divine entities to reveal their essential nature.

attributions.surface_quote: I am statements: Aretalogical self-predications in which gods reveal their divine features.

canonical_statement: The divine essence or light can become trapped or suffer within the constraints of material existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Jesus as light suffering in matter

canonical_statement: The celestial entity known as Christ exists as an aeon within the divine fullness (pleroma), distinct from the earthly manifestation of Jesus.

attributions.surface_quote: distinction is made between the heavenly Christ and the earthly Jesus

canonical_statement: Self-knowledge is a fundamental requirement for spiritual realization and the attainment of gnosis.

attributions.surface_quote: Gnostic texts reflect extensively upon the meaning of knowing oneself.

canonical_statement: Sacred or ritual water exists in both a terrestrial form and a corresponding heavenly archetype.

attributions.surface_quote: there are heavenly and earthly Jordans

canonical_statement: The divine essence is inherently immutable and incapable of suffering or death.

attributions.surface_quote: Jesus is divine and cannot suffer and die.

canonical_statement: A metaphysical boundary exists to preserve the integrity of the divine fullness from external corruption.

attributions.surface_quote: A limit separates the world inside the pleroma from the world outside.

canonical_statement: The cosmos is permeated by a divine rational principle or creative word.

attributions.surface_quote: The divine logos is the reason and rationality that permeate the cosmos.

canonical_statement: Gender categories are used symbolically to denote spiritual or heavenly states.

attributions.surface_quote: Male is a category used symbolically to designate what is spiritual and heavenly.

canonical_statement: The highest divine manifestation is identified as the heavenly spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: The great Mana is the heavenly spirit, the highest divine manifestation.

canonical_statement: A liminal ontological region exists between the divine fullness and the material world, characterized as a state of death.

attributions.surface_quote: The middle is the region between the pleroma and this world, a place of death.

canonical_statement: Cosmic vehicles facilitate the return of light-substance to its divine origin.

attributions.surface_quote: Moon is a cosmic vehicle to help transport the light back to the kingdom.

canonical_statement: Planetary powers function as structural components of the material world.

attributions.surface_quote: Nbu is one of the planetary powers of this world.

canonical_statement: The material world is the creation of a demonic entity.

attributions.surface_quote: Nebroel Namrael, demonic creator of the material world

canonical_statement: The divine realm exists beyond the planetary spheres and the fixed stars.

attributions.surface_quote: The ninth refers to the realm beyond the seven planetary spheres

canonical_statement: The mind (Nous) serves as the primary manifestation of the divine.

attributions.surface_quote: Nous, the primary manifestation of the divine.

canonical_statement: The divine essence is characterized by absolute unity.

attributions.surface_quote: the divine is frequently characterized as embracing oneness

canonical_statement: The divine entity can exist in a state of death while simultaneously maintaining life.

attributions.surface_quote: Osiris dies and yet lives as the king of underworld

canonical_statement: The soul is represented by the symbol of a pearl.

attributions.surface_quote: Pearl Symbol of the soul in the Song of the Pearl

canonical_statement: The phoenix serves as a symbol for the cyclical nature of death and renewal.

attributions.surface_quote: Phoenix... dies by fire, and rises, renewed, from its own ashes

canonical_statement: Faith and wisdom are linked as a singular metaphysical principle.

attributions.surface_quote: Pistis Sophia Faith wisdom

canonical_statement: The divine pleroma constitutes the complete manifestation of the transcendent deity.

attributions.surface_quote: The divine pleroma is thus the full manifestation of the glory of the transcendent god.

canonical_statement: Spirit is a primal power existing as a fundamental root between light and darkness.

attributions.surface_quote: spirit is the primal power or root between light and darkness.

canonical_statement: The material body functions as a restrictive prison or tomb for the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: The body is the prison or tomb of the soul.

canonical_statement: The material world is a creation of demonic entities through the mechanism of sexuality.

attributions.surface_quote: demons... create the creatures of the material world through sexuality.

canonical_statement: Humanity is ontologically divided into three distinct categories based on spiritual capacity.

attributions.surface_quote: Highest of three divisions of humanity.

canonical_statement: The human soul exists in two modes: as an animating force for physical life and as an immortal essence.

attributions.surface_quote: Psyche is sometimes the animate soul... sometimes the immortal soul within people.

canonical_statement: Humanity is categorized into three ontological tiers: material, psychic, and pneumatic.

attributions.surface_quote: Psychic is the middle of three divisions of humanity.

canonical_statement: The material world is a construct of a demiurgic entity.

attributions.surface_quote: Ptahil is the demiurge in Mandaean thought.

canonical_statement: Ritual acts involving physical elements can facilitate the transition of the soul to the divine realm.

attributions.surface_quote: Redemption uses oil and water to aid the dead in their transition.

canonical_statement: Divine rest is an ontological state of peace accessible only through the attainment of gnosis.

attributions.surface_quote: Rest is reserved for people who attain gnosis.

canonical_statement: The transcendent One exists in a state of silence and absolute repose.

attributions.surface_quote: The transcendent One is in silence and at rest.

canonical_statement: The material world and its powers were generated by the fall of a wisdom-spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: Ruha is the spirit of wisdom who falls and creates the powers of this world.

canonical_statement: The material world is the creation of a flawed or demonic demiurge.

attributions.surface_quote: Sakla or Saklas, demiurge or creator of this world.

canonical_statement: There exists a fundamental ontological distinction between higher and lower manifestations of wisdom.

attributions.surface_quote: Distinction between higher wisdom (Sophia) and lower wisdom (Achamoth).

canonical_statement: Human existence is characterized by a cycle of incarnation and reincarnation.

attributions.surface_quote: Samsara: Cycle of incarnation and reincarnation.

canonical_statement: The serpent figure functions as a catalyst for the acquisition of gnosis.

attributions.surface_quote: Serpent, as dispenser of gnosis, is considered an instructor in knowledge.

canonical_statement: The number seven represents the structural completeness of the celestial spheres.

attributions.surface_quote: Seven is the ancient number of completeness.

canonical_statement: The material realm is governed by a demiurgic entity stationed within the planetary spheres.

attributions.surface_quote: The seventh or hebdomad refers to the realm of the planetary spheres, over which the demiurge is stationed.

canonical_statement: The soul is an entity susceptible to corruption through external material influence.

attributions.surface_quote: the soul is described as a female who has an external womb and is seduced and defiled by wanton males.

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine principle exists in a state of ineffable transcendence prior to manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: the divine invisible spirit is said to be ineffable, dwelling in silence, at rest, before everything.

canonical_statement: The physical body of a savior figure may be distinct from the spiritual entity, allowing for substitution in historical events.

attributions.surface_quote: another (either Simon or the body that Jesus adopted) was crucified instead of Jesus.

canonical_statement: Numerical values serve as symbolic representations of ontological states, where six signifies material incompleteness.

attributions.surface_quote: Six Number of incompleteness, used as a numerical symbol for matter.

canonical_statement: Divine wisdom is a personified entity capable of descending from a state of glory and undergoing subsequent restoration.

attributions.surface_quote: Sophia Divine wisdom, personified, who falls from glory and is restored in gnostic myths.

canonical_statement: Higher and lower manifestations of wisdom exist as distinct aspects of the divine.

attributions.surface_quote: manifested in higher wisdom (Sophia) and lower wisdom (Achamoth)

canonical_statement: The sun functions as a metaphysical vehicle facilitating the return of light to its divine origin.

attributions.surface_quote: Sun: Ship of the day, a cosmic vehicle to help transport the light.

canonical_statement: The pleroma is structured through the union of paired aeons.

attributions.surface_quote: Syzygos: Partner or companion, especially in a heavenly syzygy or union of a pair of aeons.

canonical_statement: The physical human form is constructed by a multitude of angelic entities.

attributions.surface_quote: In the Secret Book of John three hundred sixty-five angels assemble the body of Adam.

canonical_statement: The physical body functions as a restrictive enclosure or prison for the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: The body is the prison or tomb of the soul.

canonical_statement: The material cosmos is governed by a series of authorities or powers created by a demiurgic entity.

attributions.surface_quote: Cosmic authorities produced by the demiurge.

canonical_statement: The individual possesses a divine counterpart or heavenly double that represents the true self.

attributions.surface_quote: One's divine counterpart is the twin, alter ego, or true self.

canonical_statement: There exists a metaphysical boundary or veil separating the realm of light from the external world.

attributions.surface_quote: A veil separates the world within the pleroma from the world outside.

canonical_statement: The material world is the creation of a demiurgic entity distinct from the ultimate divine source.

attributions.surface_quote: Yaldabaoth Demiurge or creator of this world.

canonical_statement: Life is an enlightened principle or aeon that exists as an afterthought hidden within the human form.

attributions.surface_quote: Zoe is the enlightened afterthought hidden within Adam.

canonical_statement: Time is an infinite divine principle or deity.

attributions.surface_quote: Zurvan God of infinite time.

canonical_statement: There exists a primordial, archetypal source of all divine revelation and cosmic knowledge, referred to as the Mother of Books.

attributions.surface_quote: The Mother of Books

canonical_statement: Human identity is categorized into distinct ontological states including earthly, heavenly, psychical, and spiritual dimensions.

attributions.surface_quote: Humanity exists in earthly, heavenly, psychical, and spiritual states.

canonical_statement: The material world is governed by a demiurgic or malevolent deity distinct from the ultimate source.

attributions.surface_quote: Adonai is an evil deity worshiped by Moses.

canonical_statement: Humanity is composed of a fundamental essence of light.

attributions.surface_quote: There exists a human essence of light.
